subject: MiraTech renewal QBR + roadmap demo — exec coverage & tech deep-dive slots
messages:
From: Susan Wu <susan.wu@miratech.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@miratech.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — scheduling request

Hi Rafael —

Hope you had a good week. We're starting to lock the calendar for our renewal QBR and want to include a short roadmap demo focused on performance/cost improvements for our inference pipelines. Ideal window for the exec stakeholders is the week of June 21–25 (US Pacific mornings).

Two asks:
- Can you propose 2 x 90-min slots (one preferred, one backup) where Redwood can run a 45-minute exec walkthrough + 30–40 minute technical deep-dive?
- We need an engineer on the call who can answer quantization/latency questions and a short runbook for fallbacks.

Also tagging our procurement team (procurement@miratech.com) — they may have a DocuSign milestone after the QBR.

Thanks,
Susan
Director, AI Infrastructure
MiraTech

[Attachment: MiraTech_QBR_needsheet.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Wu <susan.wu@miratech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — scheduling request

Hi Susan —

Thanks — we can absolutely do that. Proposed windows (US Pacific morning):
1) Tue, Jun 22 — 09:00–10:30 PT (preferred)
2) Thu, Jun 24 — 10:00–11:30 PT (backup)

On the agenda we suggest:
- 0–5m: Welcome + goals for the QBR
- 5–50m: Exec roadmap highlights (customer impact, cost/latency outcomes)
- 50–90m: Technical deep-dive (quantization, batching, KV-cache behavior) + live Q/A

I will attend for the exec portion. Marissa will cover runbook and rollout ops. For the deep-dive we can have Sean Gallagher (inference lead) join as the engineer — I copied Marissa to confirm.

One operational question: do you want this recorded and shared internally? If procurement needs sign-off, we can include a short pricing slide and a separate session for contract milestones.

Attaching a draft agenda and a small topology image so your engineers can pre-scan.

Rafael
Head of GtM Engineering
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: MiraTech_QBR_agenda_v2.pdf (PDF, 92KB); MiraTech_network_topology.png (PNG, 180KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — scheduling request

Thanks Rafael — confirmed that Sean can take the deep-dive on either slot. We recommend the Tue 22 slot as it gives us time next week to run an internal dry-run (Mon morning).

Recording: we'll record and share the condensed recording for execs only. We'll mark the recording as internal to MiraTech and redact any internal Redwood ops items.

Also, Kimberly — can you confirm if we have any conflicts with the June 22 slot for exec coverage?

Best,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

- Runbook: Marissa will open the runbook section describing fallback to a quantized model variant and regional routing policy; she’ll send the short runbook doc after the dry-run.
